data.one_liner: A customizable OAuth client for Dio with token storage and interceptors
data.what_it_does: Provides an OAuth client that can request, refresh, and store tokens, and injects bearer tokens into Dio requests via interceptors. It supports custom grant types and pluggable storage.
use_when: You need OAuth 2.0 authentication with Dio in a Flutter or Dart app
You want to persist tokens securely on the device
You need custom grant types beyond the standard ones
avoid_when: You are using the http package instead of Dio
You need a full authentication flow with UI (e.g., Google Sign-In)
You prefer a higher-level auth SDK like firebase_auth
strengths: Simple API for token requests and refresh
weaknesses: Limited to Dio; not usable with http directly
No support for device authentication methods like biometrics
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, optionally add flutter_secure_storage for secure token storage, create OAuth instance, add BearerInterceptor to Dio

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Google OAuth with UI and platform integration

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full-featured auth with multiple providers and UI support
